name: Apple Pie
source:
"I thought there couldn't be an apple pie more delicious."

One rainy afternoon, Mochizuki Saki visited Natsumi Fumiya's house.
The two of them headed to a café called Magpie, where they noticed a customer acting strangely.
They begin to uncover the truth hidden behind his behavior.

[Translated from the [url=https://sakuramint01.kagennotuki.com/applepie/applepie_index.html]official website[/url]]
